1.name: SW
1.hint: switch node, the drain of the internal MOSFET: to the inductor and the Schottky diode; swings between GND and 28 V – keep its copper area small (p. 2, p. 6)

2.name: GND
2.hint: to a solid ground plane for heat sinking and noise (p. 6)

3.name: FB
3.hint: feedback, VFB 0.588 / 0.6 / 0.612 V: VOUT = 0.6 V × (1 + R1 / R2) with the divider R1 (to VOUT), R2 (to GND) close to the pin (p. 3, 6)

4.name: EN
4.hint: high = on, low = off (shutdown current ≤ 1 µA); unused: to VIN for automatic start-up (p. 2–3)

5.name: IN
5.hint: input supply, must be bypassed locally (p. 2); the input capacitor's loop VIN–CIN–GND as short as possible (fig. 3, p. 6)

needs.source: Xi'an Aerosemi Technology MT3608 data sheet Rev1.1 (copyright 2011), p. 6 capacitor selection: input and output ceramic capacitors of 22 µF recommended, X5R or X7R – the recommended value entered as the minimum

hints: adjustable output up to 28 V, VOUT = 0.6 V × (1 + R1 / R2); 22 µF ceramic at the output (after the diode) recommended; inductor 4.7 … 22 µH; Schottky diode with a reverse voltage above VOUT (p. 1, 6)
1.2 MHz fixed frequency, PFM at light load; switch current limit 4 A typ; thermal shutdown 155 °C (p. 1, 3)
layout (p. 6, 'must be strictly followed'): input and output capacitors close to the IC and to the ground plane, SW copper small, feedback parts close to FB

compliance.source: LCSC product data C84817 (2026-10-31): RoHS certificate listed (isRohsCert, ROHS; file name also names a halogen-free certificate); the data sheet states nothing

sources: Xi'an Aerosemi Technology MT3608 data sheet Rev1.1 (copyright 2011), via LCSC https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/87b648f6991783104e708a12c210cc63.pdf?productCode=C84817, read 2026-10-31 – Aerosemi's document (www.aerosemi.com in every footer)
pins: p. 2 SOT-23-6 top view 1 SW, 2 GND, 3 FB, 4 EN, 5 VIN, 6 NC – EasyEDA symbol of C84817 (edakit part import 2026-10-31): the same, pin 5 named IN

p. 2 absolute maximum: VIN and EN -0.3 … 26 V (vdd_max_v, IN and EN v_max_v), FB -0.3 … 6 V, SW -0.3 … 30 V, power dissipation 0.6 W, θJA 250 °C/W, θJC 130 °C/W, junction temperature 160 °C, operating temperature -40 … 85 °C

p. 3 electrical characteristics: operating input voltage 2 … 24 V (vdd_op_min_v, vdd_op_max_v, vin_min_v); UVLO ≤ 1.98 V, hysteresis 100 mV; shutdown current 0.1 / 1 µA; quiescent current PFM (no switching) 100 / 200 µA, PWM (switching) 1.6 / 2.2 mA; 1.2 MHz; maximum duty cycle ≥ 90 %; EN high ≥ 1.5 V, low ≤ 0.4 V; FB 0.588 / 0.6 / 0.612 V; SW on resistance 80 / 150 mΩ; switch current limit 4 A; thermal shutdown 155 °C
iq_a 0.0002: the PFM quiescent current without switching, max 200 µA – the switching current (PWM, 2.2 mA max) is part of the losses an efficiency would cover
vref_v 0.6: p. 3 FB voltage 0.588 / 0.6 / 0.612 V; p. 6 'The internal reference VREF is 0.6V (Typical)', VOUT = VREF × (1 + R1/R2)
efficiency 0.85: read from the graph p. 4 'Efficiency vs. Load Current' – the lowest point of the curves drawn, about 85 % at VIN 3 V, VOUT 5 V and 1 A (VOUT 18 V: about 90 % and above)

behaviour boost without a vout pin (maker-coverage FT-5): p. 1 fig. 1 and p. 5 fig. 2 – the inductor from VIN to SW and the diode from SW to VOUT are outside the IC, the only switch M1 lies from SW to GND, nothing in the path from VIN to VOUT; with EN low (p. 2 'a low input turns it off') the input reaches the output through the inductor and the diode, VIN − VD – the simulation takes the output behind the diode on SW and switches the converter off by EN

hot_loop vin, sw, gnd: p. 6 layout consideration and fig. 3 – the red trace VIN–CIN–GND 'as short as possible', SW node small, input and output capacitors close to the IC; REQ.missing adds the output net behind the diode on SW
LCSC product data C84817 (2026-10-31): XI'AN Aerosemi Tech MT3608, 62 749 pcs; JLCPCB catalogue (edakit part search, 2026-10-31): Extended Part, 64 553 pcs
notes: Asynchronous boost converter, adjustable by a feedback divider. Behaviour boost (maker-coverage FT-5): the output is the net behind the Schottky diode on SW, set by the divider and VREF 0.6 V; EN low switches the converter off and the simulation shows what the inductor and the diode pass from the input. Library draft, group power.

verified.datasheet: Xi'an Aerosemi Technology MT3608 data sheet Rev1.1 (copyright 2011)
checked: SOT-23-6 pinout p. 2 = EasyEDA symbol of C84817 (1 SW, 2 GND, 3 FB, 4 EN, 5 IN, 6 NC)
absolute maximum p. 2: VIN, EN 26 V, FB 6 V, SW 30 V, 0.6 W, θJA 250 °C/W, TJ 160 °C, -40 … 85 °C
electrical characteristics p. 3: VIN 2 … 24 V, UVLO, quiescent currents, EN thresholds, VFB 0.6 V ±2 %, 1.2 MHz, 4 A limit
applications p. 6: VOUT = VREF (1 + R1/R2), 22 µF input and output ceramic, 4.7 … 22 µH, layout rules and fig. 3

2026-10-31, behaviour boost (FT-5): VREF 0.6 V p. 3 and 6 (vref_v), efficiency read from the graph p. 4 (85 %), EN p. 2 ('a low input turns it off', thresholds p. 3), the inductor and diode outside the IC with M1 from SW to GND, fig. 1 p. 1 and fig. 2 p. 5
open: efficiency is one number read from a graph (p. 4, the lowest curve point, 85 %); the curves rise with VIN and VOUT

with EN low the data sheet says only 'a low input turns it off' (p. 2); that the input reaches the output through the inductor and the diode follows from fig. 1 and fig. 2, not from a sentence of the data sheet
the shutdown current (0.1 / 1 µA, p. 3) is not in the model: with EN low the converter draws nothing
the recommended 22 µF output capacitor sits on the net behind the diode, not on a pin of the MT3608 – no need entered for it
'2A' in the title is not defined in the tables (switch current limit 4 A typ) – no i_out_max_a
switching frequency (1.2 MHz), maximum duty cycle (≥ 90 %) and the UVLO threshold have no fields in the schema
EN: no internal pull-up or pull-down stated
hot_loop names vin besides the handbook's generic sw, gnd of an asynchronous boost – from the data sheet's fig. 3
